meta.name: Rolling Spread
meta.description: On the one-minute BTC up/down: record fair minus ask on every book change into a rolling window of the last 20 readings. Once at least 10 readings are in, buy up at market when the average discount is over 3 cents, the readings are tight (range under 2 cents), at least 3 of them exceeded 5 cents, and the discount is not shrinking (newest at least the oldest). Once per window.

body.name: buy_up
body.if: count(state.spreads) >= 10 and sum(state.spreads) / count(state.spreads) > 0.03 and max_of(state.spreads) - min_of(state.spreads) < 0.02 and count_where(state.spreads, abs(entry.value - param.mid) > 0.05) >= 3 and count_where(state.spreads, if entry.value > 0 then true else false) >= 1 and newest(state.spreads) >= oldest(state.spreads)
